title: Bread for the Neighbors

readiness.math: reading the numerals 2 to 4; counting out a set of that many
readiness.reading: numerals only; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Here are the baskets for our neighbors. Look at the number on each one: that's how many people live in that house.

steps.prompt: Read the number on each basket. Put that many rolls inside.
steps.hint: Touch each roll as you count: one, two... Stop when you reach the number on the basket.

feedback.full: This basket already has {n} rolls. That's just right for this house.
feedback.all_good: Every basket has the right number of rolls.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Look at that! Every family will have bread today. And look: two rolls are left over. Those are for you and Miriam.

journal_line: I helped Tobias fill the bread baskets: 2 rolls, 4 rolls and 3 rolls, one for each person.
unavailable_text: The baskets are already on their way. Tobias says thank you!
